rows: One row per grant; scholar number and profile facts appear on the first row only. A scholar without grants has one profile row.
ordering: Scholar name using the existing Unicode case-insensitive sort key, then scholar ID; grants use the existing chronological grant ordering.
dates: Recorded start/end dates where present, otherwise recorded term and year; blank if neither is recorded. No inferred dates or completion deadlines.
education: All recorded education entries in the Previous degree cell; retain the previous-degree fallback when no entries exist.
remarks: Profile and grant remarks share the Remarks cell with explicit labels where needed. Profile remarks appear only on the first row.
write_behavior: Literal values replace the dedicated reporting tab's existing values, including obsolete extra columns. Other tabs are preserved.
csv_exports: Unchanged; their fuller contracts remain in EXPORT_CONTRACTS.json.
